FAQ
Common Questions
What is TaskMagic?
TaskMagic is an AI automation platform that connects to thousands of apps AND automates anything you do in a browser. Describe what you want in plain English, and TaskMagic builds, runs, and maintains the automation for you. No code, no complex workflow builders.
How is this different from Zapier or Make?
Zapier and Make only work with apps that have API integrations. If a website or tool doesn't have one, you're out of luck. TaskMagic does everything they do (app-to-app connections) plus automates anything in your browser, whether it has an API or not. And instead of building complex node diagrams, you just describe what you want in plain English.
Do I need to know how to code?
No. You describe what you want in everyday language. No coding, no technical setup, no node diagrams, no webhook configuration. If you can explain what you do manually, TaskMagic can automate it.
How do credits work?
Credits are the one thing you pay for. The AI thinks hard once, while it builds — a typical build uses about 150–250 credits. After that, each run costs just a few app credits, never an AI charge, and hand-built browser automations run on zero credits. Plans start at $29/mo for 5,000 credits and slide up to 50,000.
Do all plans have the same features?
Every plan includes the full builder, unlimited app connections, and unlimited active flows — you never hit a wall on what you can build. Bigger plans unlock more: MCP access and more tables from Pro ($79), team seats and bring-your-own-API-key from Business ($119), and unlimited everything on Scale.
Why is running so much cheaper than building?
Most AI tools run everything through expensive AI models on every execution. TaskMagic uses AI during the build phase, but the resulting automation runs deterministically without AI. You get the intelligence of an AI agent with the efficiency of traditional automation.
Does it work on any website?
Yes. TaskMagic automates the browser directly. It works on any website you can open in Chrome. No APIs, integrations, or special access required.
Is my data private?
TaskMagic runs locally on your machine via the desktop app and Chrome extension. Your automations execute in your own browser, not in the cloud. Your data never leaves your machine unless you explicitly send it somewhere.
How does the free trial work?
Every new account starts with a 7-day free trial that includes 1,000 credits — enough for roughly 4–6 automation builds. You add a card at signup but pay $0 today. After 7 days your plan continues at $29/mo unless you cancel, and we email you a reminder 2 days before your trial ends. Cancel anytime during the trial and you won't be charged.
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes. Every plan is month-to-month with no commitment. Cancel anytime from your account settings.
